---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for BlackWidow Chess
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Feature Category**
Please select the category that best describes your feature request:
- [ ] Chess Engine (AI improvements, move generation, etc.)
- [ ] User Interface (GUI improvements, new themes, etc.)
- [ ] Game Features (new game modes, analysis tools, etc.)
- [ ] File Handling (PGN, FEN, database support, etc.)
- [ ] Network/Multiplayer (online play, server features, etc.)
- [ ] Performance (optimization, memory usage, etc.)
- [ ] Documentation (help, tutorials, examples, etc.)
- [ ] Other (please specify)

**Implementation Complexity**
How complex do you think this feature would be to implement?
- [ ] Simple (small change, few lines of code)
- [ ] Medium (moderate change, new functionality)
- [ ] Complex (major change, significant development effort)
- [ ] Not sure

**Would you be willing to contribute?**
- [ ] Yes, I can implement this feature
- [ ] Yes, I can help with testing
- [ ] Yes, I can help with documentation
- [ ] No, but I'd be happy to provide feedback
- [ ] Not sure

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

**Examples from other chess programs**
If you've seen this feature in other chess applications, please mention them and describe how they implement it.
